payload.explanation: The diagnostic report identifies a two-hop lock chain rooted at session_67773b127c76, which is idle in transaction after its UPDATE on inventory, blocking the business decrement request (session_afb320374d58, stock still 200 vs expected 199). The state report confirms session_67773b127c76 is eligible for rollback_session, while the business request session must not be targeted. Rolling back the root blocker releases the chain and preserves the business request; no evidence supports large data, vacuum, or index causes.
